'''VT-N9''' was the designation of a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It relayed to Imperial forces an urgent transmission from [[Darth Malgus]].

==Behind the scenes==
VT-N9 can be found on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].
